intro: All 19 packages were merged onto one tree (local branch perf3/recheck-2026-10-15, 20 commits, 553 files) and validated together. 5 files needed manual merge resolution; an independent review of every file touched by two packages found no interaction bugs; a final verifier pass against this plan returned APPROVED on all five acceptance criteria.
checks: pass (0 errors; 779 warnings vs 786 on main)
pass (one shutdown test needed bun install to re-apply the changed @effect/platform-node patch)
pass, 245/245 files (a known order-dependent ContextPickerButton flake passed on rerun; one new test had a wrong baseline and was fixed)
notes: Claude now receives Ryco's appended system prompt (attachment instructions, project custom system prompt, token-mode instructions) through systemPrompt.append; it previously received none of it.
Adopted Claude/OpenCode provider snapshots stay valid for 6 h; their usage limits are still re-read every 5 minutes, but without starting a Claude SDK session or opencode serve. Codex is unchanged.
A Stop pressed while a turn waits for its pre-turn checkpoint now cancels the start; a lost turn.completed is repaired by a bounded, liveness-triggered history read while the thread stays open.

The server keeps the idle provider sessions of up to 4 viewed threads for up to 30 minutes; unviewed threads keep the 5-minute reaper, and a session is re-checked for an active turn right before it is stopped.

Desktop: a missing server entry or bootstrap pipe stops after 3 failed starts and shows the error dialog instead of retrying forever; the renderer origin port is recorded in userData right after selection.

The live command model keeps only the activity kinds it reads and no checkpoint file lists; after a restart a pending checkpoint revert blocks turn starts until it is recovered, as it already did while running.
A failed or timed-out project-skills read keeps the last good list and retries after 30 s instead of caching an empty list.

Terminal history is persisted append-only (full rewrite only on clear, restart, close or compaction). Subprocess activity checks no longer run every second during output: Linux reads /proc without spawning; macOS and Windows still spawn ps/PowerShell, but only on edges and the 5 s idle sweep (foreground-process detection was not possible through node-pty).
The tiny-chunk merge (#61) was measured and rejected: every variant regressed the RootAppShell gzip budget or file count; only the guard shipped.
Existing checkouts need bun install after pulling, because the @effect/platform-node patch content changed.
